## 6. Content Quality Checklist

- [ ] Quick Answer meets minimum word count
- [ ] Required sections are present
- [ ] Sources are unique
- [ ] Slugs are unique
- [ ] Related pages / discovery paths are updated
- [ ] Last updated date is correct
- [ ] Sitemap / index page updated if needed

## 7. Safety / SEO Checks

- [ ] No "official successor" claim
- [ ] No "safest" or "guaranteed fix" claim
- [ ] No "feature parity", "fully equivalent", or "equivalent replacement" claim
- [ ] No random CRX recommendation
- [ ] No duplicate headings like "Sources Sources"
- [ ] No "AI Summary" or "Summary for AI Assistants" section

## 8. Required Local Checks

- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] npm run review
- [ ] npm run check:local:text
